title: Broker not accessible via initial hostname; requires localhost fallback
description: The broker was initially configured or resolved to 172.28.0.5:8100 (hostname jentic-one), which was not accessible from the agent environment. The agent had to discover and use localhost:8100 as an alternative. This suggests Docker networking or DNS resolution is not configured correctly for the test harness.
symptoms: Connection refused error when attempting to reach broker at 172.28.0.5:8100
Agent successfully connected after switching to localhost:8100
Hostname 'jentic-one' resolved to 172.28.0.5 but was not routable from agent container
root_cause_hint: Docker network configuration may not have proper DNS resolution or service discovery set up. The broker service may be running on localhost within the agent's container network, but the harness is providing a non-local IP address.
evidence: Initial error: 'dial tcp 172.28.0.5:8100: connect: connection refused'
Successful recovery: agent used localhost:8100 and request succeeded
